# Upstream knowledge attribution

Copied upstream documentation, source PR descriptions and discussions remain attributed to their upstream authors and repositories. They are separate from TrainFlow-authored guidance and are not relicensed by this project’s MIT license. Original URLs, commits and original attribution are retained in each page. Source navigation lists paths, not copied implementation files.

The following repository notices accompany the retained documents. File-specific notices continue to apply; inspect the original before reusing code from a document or PR.
